description: A two-channel touch controller: dragging a pad sets a level, and the output slides to that level at a rate you choose

params.text: Drag to set that channel's level, 0V at the bottom and 10V at the top, which the output then slides to at the rate set by RATE
An attenuverter setting the range of that channel's CV output: at full right the pad gives 0-10V, at full left 0 to -10V
Transition time of that channel's CV, from 0 for an instant jump to 4 seconds per volt; turning it during a transition changes the rate of the transition under way
Ties the two channels to one value, sent to both CV outputs; only the left channel's knobs and buttons have any effect, though either pad can change the value
Sets whether a recall on that channel jumps straight to the stored CV or slides to it at the rate set by RATE
Memorizes that channel's current CV, to be brought back by a trigger at its RECALL input
In the top position a slide is exponential, in the bottom position linear

inputs.text: A rising edge above 1V sends that channel to 10V, sliding at the rate set by RATE
A rising edge above 1V sends that channel to 0V, sliding at the rate set by RATE
A rising edge above 1V sets that channel's level back to the CV held by its STORE button

outputs.text: That channel's control voltage, after its ATTV knob
A 1ms trigger each time a slide on that channel finishes, wherever it finishes

notes: 0V is in the CV memory at power-up and the slide switches start off, so a recall acts as a reset until something else is stored
with Auto-return on for a pad, that channel's arrow CV inputs become level sensitive, so a transition runs only while the input is held high
menu: Rate knob x3 (max 12 s/V) — stretches the rate knob to 12 seconds per volt, so a full 0 to 10V transition takes 2 minutes instead of 40 seconds
Level sensitive arrow CV inputs — makes a transition run only while the input is held above 1V, stopping at the level reached when it falls back
Auto-return (left pad) and Auto-return (right pad) — send that pad back to a chosen percentage of its range when the mouse button is released; Off (default) leaves it where it was put
